text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was heading to the trainer's 
office…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
『The heavens, Yui, and I alone……I'll beat 
you!!』

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's kinda weird. Let's do it a little 
more… ”I'll beat you to a pulp!!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute, don't tell anyone, okay?! 
It's stupid to be able to watch cool 
practice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's actually way cooler than 
that. I didn't even finish it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a scene from one of my favorite 
delinquent manga. I swear on Gekokujou and 
declare war on the top.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“I'm the only one in the whole world who 
can do this!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But it's kinda different when I say it… 
Maybe it's not wild enough…
choice_data_list: Why don't you make it look wild?
Why don't you try striking a wild pose?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look at what they look like…! So that's 
what they're up to! That's right, those 
guys from the manga are really mad!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You might be able to tell what kind of 
world she's looking at!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright! I'm gonna get a little 
excited! Thanks!

After that, I heard a rumor that Vodka was 
working out at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A wild pose, huh……? That was definitely a 
cool pose……

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like this? Or like this? Would you prefer 
this? You're striking a surprisingly pose! 
Don't use your muscles!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited! I'm gonna go get a mirror! 
Thanks!

It looked like Vodka's research into poses 
had been enthusiastically conducted until 
late at night.
